fact: The National Information Technology Authority-Uganda (E-Government) Regulations, 2015 (S.I. 2015 No. 27), made by the ICT Minister on 4 May 2015 and gazetted on 10 June 2015, bind all public bodies and provide for inter-operable systems, a national data centre, mandatory use of the shared government backbone and e-government infrastructure (reg. 10), and information sharing in e-government services (reg. 13, which says public and private bodies may share).
